API server version to use for the base image. If unspecified, the latest stable version will be used. Compatible ranges like ~=0.11.0.dev5 stay on 0.11.0.dev5 while only newer dev builds exist, then resolve to the newest matching rc or stable release, for example 0.11.0rc1 or 0.11.0. --add-docker-compose.help: Add additional files for running the LangGraph API server with docker-compose. These files include a docker-compose.yml, .env file, and a .dockerignore file.

--allow-blocking.help: Don't raise errors for synchronous I/O blocking operations in your code.

--api-key.help: API key. Can also be set via LANGGRAPH_HOST_API_KEY, LANGSMITH_API_KEY, or LANGCHAIN_API_KEY environment variable or .env file.

--api-version.help: API server version to use for the base image. If unspecified, the latest stable version will be used. Compatible ranges like ~=0.11.0.dev5 stay on 0.11.0.dev5 while only newer dev builds exist, then resolve to the newest matching rc or stable release, for example 0.11.0rc1 or 0.11.0. Stable-floating ranges like >~=0.11.0.dev5 can also pick up future stable releases, for example 0.12.0.

--base-image.help:
Base image to use for the LangGraph API server. Pin to specific versions using version tags. Defaults to langchain/langgraph-api or langchain/langgraphjs-api.

     
Examples:
    --base-image langchain/langgraph-server:0.2.18  # Pin to a specific patch version
    --base-image langchain/langgraph-server:0.2  # Pin to a minor version (Python)

--build-command.help: Custom build command to run from the langgraph.json directory. If not provided, uses default build process.

--comment-install-cells.help: Whether to comment out install cells

--config.help: Path to configuration file declaring dependencies, graphs and environment variables

--consolidate-only.help: Only consolidate pre-paired Python and JS content.

--debug-port.help: Enable remote debugging by listening on specified port. Requires debugpy to be installed

--debugger-base-url.help: URL used by the debugger to access LangGraph API. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:[PORT]

--debugger-port.help: Pull the debugger image locally and serve the UI on specified port

--deployment-id.help: ID of an existing deployment to update. If omitted, --name is used to find or create the deployment.

--deployment-type.help: Deployment type (used when creating a new deployment).

--docker-compose.help: Advanced: Path to docker-compose.yml file with additional services to launch.

--engine-runtime-mode.help: Runtime mode. 'distributed' uses separate executor and orchestrator containers.

--fake.help: Generate fake download counts for testing purposes. This option will not make any network requests.

--host.help: Network interface to bind the development server to. Default 127.0.0.1 is recommended for security. Only use 0.0.0.0 in trusted networks

--image.help: Docker image to use for the langgraph-api service. If specified, skips building and uses this image directly. Useful if you want to test against an image already built using `langgraph build`.

--install-command.help: Custom install command to run from the build context root. If not provided, auto-detects based on package manager files.

--json.help: Emit structured JSON-lines to stdout instead of human-readable text.

--link-only.help: Only include link references in the output

--n-jobs-per-worker.help: Maximum number of concurrent jobs each worker process can handle. Default: 10

--name.help: Deployment name. Can also be set via LANGSMITH_DEPLOYMENT_NAME environment variable or .env file. Defaults to current directory name if --deployment-id is not provided.

--name-contains.help: Only show deployments whose names contain this value.

--no-browser.help: Skip automatically opening the browser when the server starts

--no-input.help: Never prompt for input; fail with an error if a required value is missing.

--no-reload.help: Disable automatic reloading when code changes are detected

--port.help: Port number to bind the development server to. Example: langgraph dev --port 8000

--postgres-uri.help: Postgres URI to use for the database. Defaults to launching a local database

--pull/--no-pull.help:
Pull latest images. Use --no-pull for running the server with locally-built images.

     
    Example:
        langgraph up --no-pull

--recreate/--no-recreate.help: Recreate containers even if their configuration and image haven't changed

--remote/--no-remote.help: Force remote or local build. By default, builds remotely if Docker is not available locally.

--replace-links.help: Replace markdown links with full URLs in the output

--revision-id.help: Specific revision ID. For build logs, defaults to latest revision.

--server-log-level.help: Set the log level for the API server.

--ssl-certfile.help: Path to an SSL certificate file for serving the development server over HTTPS.

--ssl-keyfile.help: Path to an SSL key file for serving the development server over HTTPS.

--studio-url.help: URL of the LangGraph Studio instance to connect to. Defaults to https://smith.langchain.com

--tag.help:
Tag for the docker image.

     
    Example:
        langgraph build -t my-image

--tunnel.help: Expose the local server via a public tunnel (in this case, Cloudflare) for remote frontend access. This avoids issues with browsers or networks blocking localhost connections.

--type.help: Log stream to fetch: 'deploy' shows agent server runtime logs; 'build' shows build logs (for deployments built remotely).

--verbose.help: Show more output from the server logs

--wait.help: Wait for services to start before returning. Implies --detach

--wait-for-client.help: Wait for a debugger client to connect to the debug port before starting the server

input_file.help: Path to the input markdown file.

output_file.help: Path to output the consolidated text file
